evaluations_score_range.name: evaluations_score_range
evaluations_score_range.value: ("evaluations"."score_min" IS NULL AND "evaluations"."score_max" IS NULL) OR ("evaluations"."score_min" <= "evaluations"."score_max")

mutation_experiments_effective_requires_.name: mutation_experiments_effective_requires_failing_validation
mutation_experiments_effective_requires_.value: "mutation_experiments"."outcome" NOT IN ('KILLED', 'SURVIVED') OR ("mutation_experiments"."validation_verdict" = 'FAIL' AND "mutation_experiments"."validation_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mutation_experiments"."test_record_id" IS NOT NULL)

mutation_experiments_equivalent_requires.name: mutation_experiments_equivalent_requires_passing_validation
mutation_experiments_equivalent_requires.value: "mutation_experiments"."outcome" <> 'EQUIVALENT' OR ("mutation_experiments"."validation_verdict" = 'PASS' AND "mutation_experiments"."validation_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mutation_experiments"."test_record_id" IS NULL)

rubric_drafts_succeeded_has_rubric.name: rubric_drafts_succeeded_has_rubric
rubric_drafts_succeeded_has_rubric.value: "rubric_drafts"."status" <> 'SUCCEEDED' or ("rubric_drafts"."rubric" is not null and "rubric_drafts"."validation_errors" is not null and "rubric_drafts"."finished_at" is not null)

rubric_drafts_failed_has_reason.name: rubric_drafts_failed_has_reason
rubric_drafts_failed_has_reason.value: "rubric_drafts"."status" <> 'FAILED' or ("rubric_drafts"."failure_code" is not null and "rubric_drafts"."failure_message" is not null and "rubric_drafts"."finished_at" is not null)
